summary: built and measured by ce-cad: one valid closed solid, 422.1 mm3, 0.7 g, bbox 27.72 x 27.84 x 3.610 mm (z 1.290..4.900), 1124 faces. Its three bayonet feet were measured as a MECHANISM against the real door solid: closed 0.0000 mm3, dropped 0.3 mm 3.7114 mm3 (retained), twisted 10 deg with no press 0.2735 mm3 (blocked), pressed 0.250 and twisted 10 deg 0.0000 (freed), rotated into the entry windows and dropped 0.0000 (comes out). The three C5191 contacts are cut out of the plastic with 0.020 mm clearance, which is what insert moulding does. NOT simulated and NOT moulded.
